summary: Tioga County, PA tree observation post (1910) replaced by a steel Aermotor tower in 1920; removed 1983; trail listing says the cabin still stands; height sources disagree.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower (1920) that replaced a 1910 tree observation post
facts.status_note: Register and Forest Lookouts timeline say the steel tower was removed in 1983; onX says it was demolished in 1983 and reports the cabin still stands

staffing.status: Rex Sherman named towerman on the Goodall tower, April 1949

facts.agency: Forestry department, as a 1919 notice calls it; a state forest tower per a 1968 survey description

events.note: Tree observation post about 50 feet above the ground (1910-11)

Tree post replaced by a steel Aermotor tower
Road of 10,200 feet under construction to the tower by enrollees of Darling Run Camp

corrections.why: 61 m matches no source: the 1919 notice planned a sixty-foot tower (18.3 m) and the 1968 survey description gives about 90 feet (27.4 m)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1919 notice planned a sixty-foot tower; a 1968 survey station description says the standing tower was about 90 feet. The description of the existing structure is used (27.4 m), and the plan is noted as a conflict rather than settled.
The register dates the steel tower to 1920 and the tree post to 1910; the onX listing gives a range of 1910 to 1920 for the tower and cabin. The register's dates are used and the range is noted.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 61.0 is not supported by any source and is corrected to 27.4 m (about 90 ft, 1968 survey description); the 1919 plan of sixty feet is noted as a conflict. Brief's elevation (708.7 m) matches the register's 2,325 ft (709 m). No source states an access level, so facts.access and visit are omitted. The onX Offroad listing is a crowd-sourced trail app; its cabin and demolition claims are attributed to it and not treated as a register record. The 1949 bear-hunter story is not a fire and is included only as a notable event. Used about 6 page reads and 1 search.
